text: Nurgle Plague Cultists
Spreading plague is their sworn duty. Though they appear human, their inner structure is no longer of humankind.
Nurgle Marauders (Throwing Axes)
Death Guard
They stand beyond even the Chosen of Nurgle, tending the Garden of Nurgle as its gardeners. They exude a stench so foul it can rot flesh from the bone.
Nurgle Plague Spreaders
Mounted, they can spread plague more swiftly, and flee the ravaged towns all the faster.
Nurgle Chaos Knights (Great Axe)
Nurgle's Knights wield venom-laden great axes, whose poison is potent enough to rot anything it touches, be it armour or bone.
Death Reapers
Devoted followers of Nurgle, they wield scythes as emissaries of the Father of Decay, leaving fields of bones in their wake.
Nurgle Blight Toads
Mightier toads that rarely leave the Garden of Nurgle, adorning themselves with scavenged fragments lost within it.
Nurgle Centigors
Centigors hurling venomous throwing axes - though lacking heavy armour, they move with impressive speed.
Nurgle Centigors (Great Weapons)
Centigors wielding heavy weapons to crush any foe before them. Blessed by the Plague Father, they possess resilient vitality and thicker armour.
Plague Ogres (Nurgle Soul Cannon)
Plague Ogres wield cannons of old, but what they fire forth are Nurglings nesting upon their backs.
Nurgle's Marauders hurl throwing axes to shatter the enemy's armor, a simpler and quicker way to bring them down.
